title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-13 05:53:43 最新章节：第605章 绝望
slug: 大明逆天属性我杀敌捡取长生
content_zh:
第1章首杀鞑子，开启属性！洪武二十年五月！
大宁府！
一处阴暗的林间。
一百多个身着红色战甲，手持战刀，长枪的士兵分散开来，谨慎的向着林间深处靠近着。
“都小心点。”
“老兵在前，新兵在后。”
“这一群山匪可都不是什么善茬。”
走在中间一个，身着战甲，手提战刀的领兵百户沉声道。
“是。”
众多兵卒纷纷应道。
老兵持刀在前。
新兵持弓箭在后。
“朱应。”
“都会有第一次的。”
“等下看到山匪，不要管其他，提着弓箭对着山匪的脑门射就行。”
“射死一个就是一个军功。”
在一个新兵面前，一个老兵善意的提醒道。
“老章，你就放心吧。”
“我可不怕。”
一个稍显稚嫩的新兵，当即应道。

他年龄不大，看起来只有十四五岁的样子，还是少年模样，长得倒是有着几分俊俏，显得有些文弱。
话虽然说的镇静。
不过神情还是有些紧绷的。
毕竟入伍还不到两个月，这是第一次上了剿匪的战场。
虽说大明法律森严，对待山匪恶徒有着大约束，但也架不住大明帝国的广袤，无论是怎样一个帝国，作奸犯科的人是不会少的。
落草为寇，更不少。
“妈的。”
“姓沈的，你给我等着。”
“如果以后我能回去，第一个整死你。”
看着此刻的林间透出的一种杀伐，诡异感，朱应也在心底暗骂着。
入伍从军？
这可并不是朱应想要来的，他是被人给坑来的。
在如今的大明洪武时代，兵役是世袭的，有军户籍，还有缺兵时才会招募兵卒。
朱应并非军户籍，原本是无需来入伍的，可巧合的是大宁府为了平定匪患，招募新兵，要求年龄满十六岁，朱应就被顺理成章的坑了进来了，更关键的是朱应的年龄根本就没有到十六，完全被伪造了信息，录入了军籍。
不过。
content_en:
Chapter 1: Kill the Tatars for the first time and unlock attributes! May of the 20th year of Hongwu!
Daning Mansion!
A dark forest.
More than a hundred soldiers wearing red armor, holding swords and spears spread out and cautiously approached the depths of the forest.
"Be careful."
"The veterans are in front, the recruits are behind."
"This group of bandits is not a good person."
One of the soldiers walking in the middle, Bai Hu, who was wearing battle armor and carrying a sword, said in a deep voice.
"Yes."
Many soldiers responded one after another.
The veteran holds the knife in front.
The new soldiers are behind with bows and arrows.
"Zhu Ying."
"There will always be a first time."
"When you see the bandit later, don't worry about anything else, just hold the bow and arrow and shoot at the bandit's head."
"Shooting one to death is a military merit."
In front of a new recruit, a veteran reminded him kindly.
"Lao Zhang, don't worry."
"I'm not afraid."
A slightly immature recruit responded immediately.
He is not very old, he looks like he is only fourteen or fifteen years old, and he still looks like a teenager. He is somewhat handsome and looks a bit frail.
Although he said it calmly.
However, his expression was still a bit tense.
After all, he had only been in the army for less than two months, and this was his first time on the battlefield to suppress bandits.
Although the laws of the Ming Dynasty were strict and there were great restrictions on bandits and villains, they could not withstand the vastness of the Ming Empire. No matter what kind of empire it was, there would always be many people who committed crimes.
Falling grass turns into bandits, and there are many more.
"Damn it."
"Shen, please wait for me."
"If I can go back in the future, I will be the first to kill you."
Seeing the killing and strange feeling in the forest at this moment, Zhu Ying also cursed secretly in his heart.
Enlist in the military?
This was not what Zhu Ying wanted to do, he was tricked into coming here.
In today's Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty, military service is hereditary, with military household registration, and soldiers will be recruited only when there is a shortage of soldiers.
Zhu Ying did not have a military household registration, so he did not need to enlist in the army. But coincidentally, in order to quell the banditry, Daning Mansion recruited new soldiers and required them to be over sixteen years old. Zhu Ying was naturally tricked into joining the army. What's more important is that Zhu Ying's age was not at all sixteen, so his information was completely forged and entered into the military register.
but.
